title: rlsentry report
description: The JSON report of one rlsentry run. schema_version is MAJOR.MINOR: removing or renaming a field, or changing what one means, is a new major version; adding a field is a new minor version.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the report follows.

ran_at.description: The time of the run, UTC, ISO 8601; the only field that differs between two runs on the same migrations.

postgresql.description: The exact version the copy's server ran.

postgrest.description: The exact version of PostgREST the copy ran.

migrations.description: How many migration files the copy was built from.

results.description: One entry per table of an exposed schema and operation judged, in schema-qualified name order.

verdict.description: null: no verdict (the run then ends with exit 2).

basis.description: For an exposed verdict: what it rests on; null otherwise.

requests.description: Which requests got rows the table holds.

columns.description: The columns read, when the read grant covers only some; null when it covers all.

text.description: The basis as the summary words it.

evidence.description: For an exposed verdict: one row the visitor got, as the copy holds it, on the columns read; null otherwise.

attempts.description: The requests sent: none when the table got no verdict before any request.

status.description: The HTTP status; null when no answer came.

error_code.description: The PostgreSQL error code the answer named.

rows.description: How many rows the table holds the answer held; null when it did not show the read exposed.

reason.description: Why this request did not show the read exposed.
For no verdict: why, as the summary words it; null for a verdict.

partitions.description: Partitioned tables of an exposed schema: attacked through the parent only.

not_reachable.description: Tables in schemas the REST layer does not expose, named and not attacked.

stop.description: Why the run ends with exit 2; null when it does not.

table.description: The table the run stopped at, for a stop that ended it at once.
